title: JVS la raspa pasos básicos folclor mexicano

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down basic Mexican folk steps with verbal counts and encouragement. She uses a chair as a prop to simulate partner or spatial orientation.

lesson_structure.note: Welcomes viewers and introduces La Raspa for upcoming patriotic celebrations.
Breaks down the first step with three taps and claps.
Introduces the second step mimicking Caperucita Roja skipping.
Adds a chair to practice circling around it.
Practices steps with music using the chair.
Removes chair and practices forward and backward movement.
Practices the full routine to music without a chair.

metaphors: Como si bailaras o caminaras como Caperucita Roja

steps_taught.name: Paso 1
steps_taught.description: Three taps alternating feet ending with claps.

steps_taught.name: Paso 2
steps_taught.description: Skipping step moving forward and backward around a chair.

what_works: progressive addition of props like a chair
what_hinders: Single camera angle from the front

quotes.text: Vamos a aprendernos unos pasitos del folclor mexicano
como si bailaras o caminaras como Caperucita Roja

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates three alternating foot taps followed by two claps.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution on the floor

extraction.distinctive_method: Using a household chair as a physical reference point to simulate partner dancing or spatial pathways during solo practice.
